description: Asterion Research is an internal team formed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our team brings together close friends focused on Earth observation, software engineering, machine learning, and data analytics. We leverage open NASA data to build innovative, functional, and impactful solution models. Our members work closely across ideation, development, design, and final execution to deliver a compelling hackathon entry.
summary:
AgroSatellite is a web-based agricultural platform that uses NASA Earth observation data to help monitor environmental conditions and agricultural areas. This platform was developed to make it easier for users to access information about climate conditions, the environment, and potential land fires.

By using satellite data, AgroSatellite helps users understand land conditions and use this information to make better decisions about agricultural management, including crop rotation planning.

We developed this project because environmental information plays an important role in agriculture. Through AgroSatellite, we hope to make NASA data and technology more useful in helping farmers make better decisions and supporting more sustainable agriculture.
details:
AgroSatellite is a web-based agricultural platform developed to help users understand agricultural and environmental conditions using NASA Earth observation data.

The platform works by allowing users to select an agricultural location and view information about climate, weather, and land conditions through an interactive map. It also provides satellite data layers, fire monitoring, and AI-based agricultural recommendations to help users understand their surroundings and make better farming decisions.

AgroSatellite aims to make satellite data easier to access and understand, especially for people involved in agriculture. By providing useful environmental information, the platform can help farmers plan their activities, consider suitable crop rotation, and prepare for potential climate-related risks.

We hope this project can encourage better agricultural management, reduce the risks caused by changing environmental conditions, and support more sustainable farming practices.

The prototype was developed as a web application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. During development, we also used AI tools to help generate text, correct grammar, identify bugs, and improve the code.

What makes AgroSatellite different is the way it combines NASA satellite data, interactive maps, environmental monitoring, and AI-based recommendations in one platform. Our team focused on making the platform simple to use, accessible, and useful for real agricultural needs.
